correctness.rationale: For all positive w,L,v_i,D_i,mu_i with Var(X_i(t))=2D_it and independent survival, the terminal lateral Gaussian tail is exactly (1/2)exp(-alpha_i L)erfc(beta_i/sqrt(L)). In a strict tradeoff beta1<beta2, delta=alpha1-alpha2>0, the Mills inequality erfc(z)<exp(-z*z)/(sqrt(pi)*z) implies Q(z)=z exp(-z*z)/erfc(z) is strictly increasing; therefore d/dL log(P1/P2)=-delta+[Q(beta1/sqrt(L))-Q(beta2/sqrt(L))]/(sqrt(pi)*L)<-delta. The ratio tends to +infinity at small L and zero at large L, proving one transversal crossing and its unique comparative statics. Integration-by-parts normal-tail asymptotics give Lstar~[2(beta2-beta1)/(sqrt(pi)delta)]^(2/3) as delta tends to zero and ~sqrt[(beta2^2-beta1^2)/delta] as delta tends to infinity, with rigorous endpoint limits. Exact boundary classifications are explicit. The extracted standalone source checker passed 38,011 supplementary tests, which do not replace these analytic arguments.

originality.rationale: Farò and Wolter (2024) study spatial river larval-drift scenarios using numerical particle tracking; Meyer, Hastings and Largier (2021) analyze heterogeneous mortality and dispersal in marine larval delivery. Both motivate but do not establish this terminal-threshold survival ranking as a function of downstream reach. An inspected published mathematical full RESULT.md compares drifted Brownian absorbing FIRST-ARRIVAL CDFs at a common time; this has a different event, no independent mortality multiplier and no two penalty exponents for a terminal lateral position. The Gaussian tail, Mills inequality and asymptotics are explicitly classical ingredients. Actual searches targeted the exact erfc product, aliases, models and crossover scales. No inspected direct or stronger theorem was found; incomplete historical indexing and general special-function product inequalities remain risks.
residual_risks: The first sections only of the Amos (1973) paper were read; a different general theorem about error-function products could cover the strict crossover.
Mathematical historical indexing and inaccessible manuscripts mean no absolute novelty guarantee.
Physical channels are bounded, turbulent and spatially heterogeneous; extrapolation of Gaussian terminal-side probabilities to actual settlement or management outcomes is unproved.

value.rationale: Lateral mobility and mortality per downstream distance are competing mechanisms in observed nursery access. For designs with opposite parameter advantages, the unique all-distance ranking switch gives an interpretable no-multiple-reversal benchmark and strict parameter sensitivity, not merely a numerical optimum. The two distinct sharp power exponents quantify how reach length depends on weak versus strong mortality disadvantage and allow structural checks of richer simulations. Its relevance is the precisely motivated two-parameter tradeoff and rigorous complete classification; no empirical calibration or downstream population consequence is asserted.
